ncdns.owns: disposable local DNSSEC signing keys; no name-owner or MTA keys

recorder.reads: validator read-only RPC, DNS and redacted fixture MTA logs

A.owns: provider-A disposable TLS key, A queue/mailbox

B.owns: provider-B disposable TLS key, B queue/mailbox

Bprime.owns: provider-Bprime disposable TLS key, empty independent queue/mailbox

network_policy: separate namespace and storage per authority, explicit point-to-point allowlists; mail 25 among A/B/Bprime, each local resolver to ncdns 5391, ncdns to validator RPC, validator-controller chain 18444; recorder read-only paths; no other edges or public route
storage_policy: no shared queues, mailboxes, provider keys, owner wallets or writable source; runtime HOME/TMP/cache private 0700; distinct UID/GID maps, no host homes, sockets, keys or foreign caches
